statements.text: Consciousness determines which uncertainties must be felt, that is, prioritized, in a given context. Formally, the self-state of interest is the precision given to interoceptive prediction errors, and the felt adjustment of that precision is affect. A rise in expected free energy just is bad from the perspective of a self-organizing system and a fall just is good, which is how and why it feels like something for the system.

sources.quote: In short, consciousness is felt uncertainty.
This self-state (i.e., the precision of interoceptive signals) is what we call felt uncertainty or affect.
